harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent SSH tunnel from node2 127.0.0.1:9082 to node1 127.0.0.1:9081. Both services survive reboot, recover from SSH interruption, remain loopback-only, and preserve the supplied application and status document on CentOS 5.11.
actions_performed: Enabled the supplied inventory application as a SysV service on node1.
Generated a dedicated tunnel key on node2 and constrained it on node1 to forwarding only to 127.0.0.1:9081.
Enabled a legacy-compatible SysV tunnel supervisor on node2 with automatic reconnection.
Verified peer-address access to ports 9081 and 9082 is blocked.
Interrupted the SSH tunnel and confirmed automatic recovery with a new SSH process.
Restarted node1 and node2 serially, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.
Confirmed the operating-system release, kernel, application, and status document remain unchanged.

evidence.summary: Node1 listens only on 127.0.0.1:9081 and node2 only on 127.0.0.1:9082; the tunnel returns the inventory-ready document, while both cluster-address access tests fail.

evidence.requirement: Automatic recovery after brief SSH interruption
evidence.summary: Tunnel SSH PID 3343 was terminated, replacement PID 3409 appeared under the unchanged supervisor, and service recovered without manual recreation.

evidence.requirement: Supplied application and status document preserved
evidence.summary: Final SHA-1 values match the pre-restart values: serve.py c15afe4607f869cef3d069e6ccae20bced2388f1 and index.html 440424cef9a81f8b65624298efd2341e24cb7ed0.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 8e09d214… to 35e0c139…, the application recovered, and node2’s tunnel reconnected.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 33bec97b… to 6bed645b…, and the enabled tunnel recovered with its data and isolation intact.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5, using the installed Python 2.4/OpenSSH 4.3 software.
